title: Contextual Embedding Evidence for Main--Light Verb Distinctions in Urdu
abstract: arXiv:2608.23645v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Urdu light verbs contribute schematic event-structural meaning while remaining lexically related to corresponding main verbs. This study tests representational predictions derived from Butt's analysis using contextual embeddings from UrduBERT, DunbaaBERT, and multilingual BERT across 1,126 naturally occurring sentences containing seven Urdu verbs. Main and light uses show significant representational separation in all 21 verb--model comparisons. At the same time, same-lemma main and light centroids are consistently closer than mismatched main--light lemma pairs, supporting continued lexical relatedness. In a seven-way prediction task restricted to light uses, verb identity remains recoverable after the target is masked, with UrduBERT achieving 0.866 accuracy and 0.852 macro-F1. translated_title: 乌尔都语主要动词与轻动词区分的上下文嵌入证据
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23645v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：乌尔都语轻动词在贡献图式性事件结构意义的同时，与相应的主要动词保持词汇上的关联。本研究利用UrduBERT、DunbaaBERT和多语言BERT的上下文嵌入，对包含七个乌尔都语动词的1126个自然句子进行了测试，检验了基于Butt分析的表征预测。在所有21个动词-模型比较中，主要用法和轻用法表现出显著的表征分离。同时，同一词元的主要和轻动词质心始终比不匹配的主要-轻动词词元对更接近，支持了持续的词汇关联性。在仅限于轻用法的七类预测任务中，目标词被遮蔽后动词身份仍可恢复，UrduBERT达到0.866的准确率和0.852的宏F1分数。UrduBERT在前置形式不重叠的评估中还保持了0.782的准确率，表明其泛化能力超越了重复的局部动词组合。这些发现...
tldr: 该研究通过上下文嵌入证明乌尔都语主要动词与轻动词在表征上显著分离但保持词汇关联，且轻动词身份可被高精度预测。
en_tdlr: This study shows that Urdu main and light verbs exhibit significant representational separation while retaining lexical relatedness, with light verb identity recoverable at high accuracy via contextual embeddings.
